subject: SLA clemency: Asteria Health latency window & remedy proposal
messages:
From: Daniel Park <ops@asteriahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: sustained latency 2027-03-08 & request for remedy

Marissa,

We saw a prolonged latency window on 2027-03-08 where our production traffic to model redwood/gpt-13 resulted in token latencies spiking to ~1.2s (p50 moved from 120ms to ~650ms, p95 crossed 1s) for roughly a 3-hour window. That period impacted two customer-facing features and triggered incident alerts on our side.

Attached is our extracted 1-hour summary + request trace (asteria_latency_report_Q1.csv). We raised this to your support channel but wanted a formal remediation proposal and a concession outline for our finance/legal teams — specifically:
- confirmation of root cause and mitigation steps
- proposed credit or make-whole for customer-facing impact (we're thinking a one-month service credit or a monetary offset)
- a commitment on changes that prevent recurrence (SLA guardrails, routing, fallback)

We prefer a simple commercial remedy to present to our CFO; happy to take a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Daniel Park
Head of Platform, Asteria Health
ops@asteriahealth.com

Attachments: asteria_latency_report_Q1.csv (csv)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 09:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: sustained latency 2027-03-08 & request for remedy

Team — forwarding Asteria's incident summary. Short ask: can we 1) validate our incident root cause and 2) approve a commercial remedy so I can get Daniel something to present to his CFO?

Background: the spike aligns with an autoscaling lag on one of their dedicated shards; our telemetry suggests fallback to a lower-throughput host and a brief queueing blip. Support has a log excerpt in the attached playbook snippet.

Options I sketched (attached as proposed_remedy_options_v1.docx):
Option A — One-month service credit (pro-rated by usage), no changes to contract
Option B — 50% credit for two months + one dedicated health check and runbook review
Option C — $X one-time monetary offset tied to verified customer impact metrics

Please indicate preferred option and any constraints (finance, legal, precedence). If exec signoff required, I can aggregate and route to Vivek.

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: sustained latency 2027-03-08 & request for remedy

Marissa / Aditya — reviewed the telemetry and the cost model. Quick notes:
- Root cause: transient autoscaler slow-down during shard rebalancing; our fallback path worked but increased wait-time (confirmed by infra).
- Likely customer impact: elevated error budget usage and a degraded UX window; Asteria's report aligns with our traces.

Commercial recommendation for approval: Option B with a tweak.
  - 40% credit applied to Asteria's subscription for two billing cycles (rounded to nearest invoice),
  - one operational health-check (2-engineer, 4-hr review) included at no charge, and
  - a commitment to add a cross-region fallback test to our standard canary within 30 days.

Rationale: Option B balances remediation cost (~$12k revenue hit estimate) vs. retention risk given Asteria's growth profile. Legal: have them sign a short acknowledgement (non-precedent) — Maya Chen (Asteria legal) may want language that preserves our right to adjudicate credits per contract.

As this is >$10k estimate, I'm escalating for Vivek's signoff. If Vivek approves, Marissa please draft a short concession letter and route to DocuSign (I can provide the finance routing code).

-Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: sustained latency 2027-03-08 & request for remedy

Thanks team — I've reviewed the recommendation and the cost estimate. Approve Option B (as adjusted by Karthik) with one change: change the credit from 40% x 2 cycles to 35% x 3 cycles to smooth the impact to our monthly recognition and to show stronger remediation. Keep the health-check and the 30-day canary addition.

Conditions:
- Concession is documented as a one-off commercial remedy tied to incident ID RWI-2027-03-08-042 and labelled "non-precedential".
- Legal to sign an acknowledgement; Marissa, loop in legal if Asteria asks for broader contract language.
- Finance: route through the refund/credit pipeline and tag DEAL-4532.

Marissa — please send Daniel a concession letter with the above terms and a proposed timeline for the runbook review. After their acknowledgement, prepare DocuSign.

Vivek
VP, Customer Success & GTM Operations
Redwood Inference
